title: Norwegian Sausage Crumble
description: A hearty and flavorful dish made with Norwegian sausage, crumble, and umami flavors.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the sliced sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a separate bowl, combine the crumble, butter, and dried umami.
Add the crumble mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook time may vary depending on the size of your sausage and crumble mixture.
